name: Surgery
overview: Scripture encourages believers to find strength and courage in the Lord during times of physical weakness or fear, assuring that God will never forsake or fail them (Deuteronomy 31:6; Joshua 1:9). In moments of sickness or distress, God provides healing and comfort, binding wounds and strengthening the afflicted (Psalms 41:3; Psalms 147:3). Trusting in God's presence and help dispels fear and dismay, reminding believers that His righteous hand upholds them through all challenges (Psalms 56:3; Isaiah 41:10). This foundation invites a Christ-centered perspective on surgery, including cosmetic and plastic procedures, recognizing God's sovereign care over healing and restoration.
